summary: Senstar Technologies Corp filed a Form 6-K containing its Notice of Annual Meeting of Shareholders and Proxy Statement for the meeting to be held on June 29, 2026. The agenda includes receiving audited financial statements, electing directors, and appointing Ernst & Young LLP as auditor. The board unanimously recommends voting for the proposals. This is a routine annual meeting filing with no special-situation event such as a merger, tender offer, or activist campaign. As a foreign private issuer, the filing is the equivalent of a U.S. definitive proxy statement on Schedule 14A and is ordinary-course governance.
